item.title: Senior home equity at record high as Trump opposes price cuts
item.description: Housing wealth held by homeowners age 62 and older climbed 1.9% in the third quarter of 2025 to a record $14.66 trillion.

item.title: January jobs data beats estimates, but mortgage rates barely budge
item.description: Normal job creation levels of the past are now looked at as big beats, and that has lowered the unemployment rate to 4.3%.

item.title: Rezzie marketplace launches for off-market investment properties
item.description: Rezzie connects investors and wholesalers for off-market properties, offering analytics and buy box tools for targeted deal matching.

item.title: Jim Barcelona promoted to EVP at Chicago @properties Christie’s International Real Estate
item.description: @properties Christie’s International Real Estate names Jim Barcelona as EVP and gives new roles to Mike Long and Kevin Rynes.

item.title: QXO set to acquire Kodiak Building Partners for $2.25 billion
item.description: QXO will acquire Kodiak Building Partners for $2.25B, expanding its reach and signaling more deals in the $800B building products sector.

item.title: Ken Pozek of Orlando’s The Pozek Group joins Real Brokerage board
item.description: Real Brokerage named Ken Pozek to its board, adding an agent-focused leader with 23 years of experience and a top-performing Orlando team.

item.title: Housing market weathers storm disruption, sets up for spring
item.description: New listings and pending sales dipped in late January, driven by a snowstorm rather than broader housing market trends.

item.title: Exclusive: Pennymac to acquire subservicing giant Cenlar for $257.5M
item.description: Pennymac’s first M&A deal adds 2 million loans and expands its mortgage servicing to more than $1 trillion in unpaid principal balance.

item.title: Consumer group sues Unison, alleging deceptive marketing of ‘no-debt’ home equity investment
item.description: Unison, one of the nation’s leading providers of home equity investments, is facing a lawsuit from the National Association of Consumer Advocates, which alleges the company deceptively markets its product as a “no-debt” home equity alternative.
